No package manager or network access is required to build or run Relatum with
these assets. The `notes.mermaid` feature owns the entire directory. Notes load
this runtime only for a visible Mermaid block; the other Markdown surfaces keep
their existing Mermaid.js runtime. Upgrade only with compatibility, resource
boundary, security, lifecycle and browser regression checks.
